name: Prospective protocol for a new retrospective frozen-model section-intensity measurement
binding_authority: Parent reviews and binds before any scientific data read/forward. No source edits, tests, model calls, target-derived qualification or metrics were run to draft this proposal.

supersedes.reason: Parent now requires per-frame plus per-section scalar intensity. Proposed row8 cap is12MiB, with3 learned arms+beat-trigger+constant ratio1; no reference-pose read. The previously suggested real-motion comparator is explicitly not part of this narrower candidate because original G-struct-contrast does not require it. No component is selected or dropped after outcomes.

question: For the exact three frozen historical JD models, what is the emitted DMX intensity contrast between cached heuristic drop and breakdown labels, versus no-structure, original shuffled-structure, beat-trigger and a constant-intensity null?
instrument: Frozen historical-model + ConductorHybrid + canonical14-fixture rig packed-DMX decoded mean(dimmer*max(HSV_value,1e-6)), conditioned on frozen unvalidated JD heuristic role labels. Not physical luminance, screen brightness, human preference, true annotated musical structure, or a new light-BAS/FID test.

Parent must explicitly bind this interpretation before outcomes; this is not claimed as a recovered historical numerical threshold.

components_kept_open: Original G-struct-lift and G-struct-shuffle primary failures remain unchanged; no repeat or rescue.
The originally promised independent Oslo-boundary label validation remains absent. Heuristic-role contrast does not silently replace it.

clock_and_conditioning.clip_T_source: Frozen tensor JSONmeta T; total371393 frames across original40. No truncation/extension to improve coverage. If approved bus has fewer frames than required, stop that material and report pre-inference eligibility failure, not silently substitute. Parent binds complete-case cohort before prediction.
clock_and_conditioning.offset_source: justdance_motion_index.json start_s for the exact clip. i0=int(round(start_s*40)), required indices i0:i0+T. t_clip=i/40; t_source_sample=(i0+i)/40; save start_s and its roundoff separately. Original slice_bus subtracts sampled first timestamp, while beat times subtract exact start_s. Preserve this convention; do not phase-align or retime by outcome.
guards: Validate fps40; times finite and monotone and adjacent increments consistent with0.025s within1e-4s (float32storedclock tolerance); mel64xT and28named scalar channels finite/aligned.

For actual source-file time checks use1e-4s absolute tolerance because originaltimes are float32 near fullsong duration. If that tolerance is insufficient, stop and revise before inference rather than resampling.

arms.struct: Original role onehot intro/breakdown/build-up/drop/outro + energy + tanh(to_rise_s/30) + tanh(to_drop_s/30), source song offseti0.
arms.shuf: Same8channels from original donor atoffset0, same target audio/clip. Preserve original conditioning-tail zeros when donor shorter; record padding and donor support. Do not count padded conditioning as observed role truth.

clock_and_conditioning.structure_coverage: Validate allowed roles0..4, one finite time grid and nonoverlapping metadata segments within recording duration. Scoring roles use TARGET song, never donor roles. Mark gaps/out-of-range as invalid255, not automatic intro. Log true conditioning and donor support fractions. Outcome role masks use only validated cached target spans.
clock_and_conditioning.role_eligibility_before_predictions: Use target-role/scaler/input metadata only. Require >=95% of targetclip frames covered by valid cached segments; require drop and breakdown each include >=80frames retained from segment intersections of>=80frames. Report all40 eligibility decisions before model outputs. An empty/very small paired cohort remains a reported inconclusive component, not permission to choose different songs/roles.
clock_and_conditioning.target_role_assignment: Assign outcome role and sectionID from the TARGET cache at EXACT indices i0+i, i0=round(raw_start_s*40), the same indices used by structure_channels real conditioning. For segment metadata checks use t_source_sample=(i0+i)/40, not raw_start_s+i/40. Keep original rolecache classification; do not regenerate labels from RMS. Save raw_start_s, rounded_origin_s=i0/40, delta_s=rounded_origin_s-raw_start_s, abs(delta_s)<=0.0125s+1e-9, and localframeindex. Beats retain legacy rawoffset subtraction. Donor conditioning uses donorindexi, never targeti0; target scoring is unchanged across arms.
clock_and_conditioning.length_guard: Actual approved bus slice length must equal frozen metadataT. Do not autotruncate to min(lengths) or pad audio. A mismatch is a material-qualification failure reported BEFORE any outputs and requires parent-approved explicit amendment if repair is proposed. Structure conditioning-tail zeros may reproduce the original function only where source arrays end; their support is logged and they never become observed scoring roletruth.
clock_and_conditioning.feature_nan_contract: Original structure_channels maps NaN energy/to_rise_s/to_drop_s to0 then applies tanh to distances. Preserve that exact frozen transform and log missing counts; do not newly interpolate or replace labels. Validate resulting model features finite. Role validity/coverage is independent and cannot be inferred from a finite padded feature.

generation_and_mapper.sampling: NEW retrospective draws. The archived code indicates seed0 was the brightness arm, but original RNG states/library/device/kernel schedule were not saved. Do not claim these predictions equal original predictions. Use a newly instantiated same-device generator seeded0 at each clip for each of the3models, with identicalC17 noise-call shapes/order; this gives common noise across arms. No seed search. One draw estimates song variation conditional on that draw, not style/training-seed uncertainty.
generation_and_mapper.replay_receipt: Record device, torch/CUDA/NumPy versions, dtype, deterministic flags, initial/final generator-state hashes per clip/arm and noise-call shape schedule. Verify same generator states/schedule across arms. No need to save the full noise tensor. If equality fails, stop; do not run different seeds until a favorable ratio appears.
generation_and_mapper.chunking: Preserve historical chunk2400 and priming6*(160-1+15-1)+1=1039frames. Preserve original ARFlowHead.sample3Eulersteps, clamp6, y_prev reset per chunk, and sampling of overlap context before keeping output slice. Do not replace with a cheaper chunk or cachedA/C trace.
generation_and_mapper.mapper: ConductorHybrid with fixed ConductorConfig below, canonical club_rig14fixtures. Produce packed512-channel DMX only transiently in RAM to retain original8bit fixture coding; decode to scalarbrightness and discard DMX. Do not instantiate renderer or save DMX.
generation_and_mapper.beat_trigger: Frozen render_beat_trigger same approvedbus, same canonicalrig40fps delay0; its existing per-clip5th/95th percentile audio normalization is a fixed deterministicbaseline rule, not a newly fitted model. No baseline tuning.
generation_and_mapper.brightness_matching: None: preserve exact mapper values. No per-section brightness matching. No wholeclip normalization beyond existing frozen model/scaler/conductor algorithms.

required_outputs_and_instrument.per_frame: For eachclip save four float32brightness vectors [none,struct,shuf,beat_trigger], shared int32frameindex, uint8targetrole(valid roles0..4,invalid255), uint16sectionID(invalid65535); clipindex recordsT/fps/i0/start_s/identity/oldalias/eligibility and sourcehashes. NoDMX/predictedpose/fullmodelactivations.
required_outputs_and_instrument.scalar_definition: brightness = mean_j decoded_dimmer_j*max(decoded_val_j,1e-6) across all14fixtures, after pack_universe/decode_stream. Existing decoder treats some fixture dimmers as RGB value too, so blinder contribution may effectively be squared; preserve instrument exactly and do not call it radiometric energy.
required_outputs_and_instrument.per_section: For every intersection retain clip,canonical,recording,arm,segmentID,role,start/end frames,valid/retained counts, sum and mean scalarintensity. Include rejected/too-short sections with explicit reasons, not just favorable roles. Accumulate float64 statistics from the SAVED float32brightness vectors so reanalysis exactly matches saved data.
required_outputs_and_instrument.precision_checks: Assert allsaved scalar intensities finite and in[0,1] within1e-6; log clamped/zero counts without modifying values. Any nonfinite arm causes failure for the registered component, never replacement by another run. Filehashes and schemas permit independent table recomputation.

estimands_and_uncertainty.ratio: For each eligibleclip/arm take mean across retained drop frames divided by mean across retained breakdown frames. Breakdown<=1e-8=>undefined; no epsilon rescue. Logratio then equal-coach average within recording, equal-recording average within canonicalfamily, equal-canonical average across cohort; exponentiate forR.
estimands_and_uncertainty.pairing: Use same prequalified clips and rolemasks across fourarms. If model-specific undefineddenominator occurs, retain explicit missingness, report predeclared complete-case paired subset with every exclusion; do not count missingarm as zero or silently promote a gate. Must report original40 and27 sensitivity denominators at clip/recording/canonical levels.
estimands_and_uncertainty.CI: 10000 paired canonical-family bootstrapresamples withfixedseed20260928, two-sidedpercentile95% intervals. Preserve nested coach/recording means within cluster. Return undefinedCI if <2independent eligiblecanonicalfamilies; if fewer than10, label low-support descriptive. No pooledclip bootstrap. No trainingseed/stylevariance claim.
estimands_and_uncertainty.multiplicity: Primary descriptive endpoint isR_struct in publishedfactor-toleranceband, withCI. Allpairedimprovement/null contrasts exploratory, not a new combined confirmationgate. If parent wants inferential superiority claims, bind a multiplicity-controlled family before outcomes; never retrospectively choose one favorable contrast.

nulls.constant: Constant positive intensity gives drop/breakdownR=1 exactly, noforward/file/fit needed. This is not the tied-scoreAP issue fromrow11.
nulls.within_clip_role_shift: Use fourfixed circular shifts round(f*T), f in{.2,.4,.6,.8}, applied jointly to retainedtarget rolemask/sectionID/validmask against SAVED intensity. Preserve includedmask counts and roles; do not rerun any model. These are clip-local circular nulls, not fullsong truth. Use identicalshiftfractions acrossarms, report allfour andtheir meanlogratio. Compare true-logratio minus average shifted-logratio percanonicalfamily withthe same bootstrapcluster units. Shiftreplicates are not additionalindependent songs.
nulls.shuffle_model_control: Keep the exact frozen shufmodel AND recoveredoriginaldonormapping. Circularrole shift is an added scorecontrol, not a replacement for shuffledconditioning. Do not choose newdonors or refit shufmodel.

runtime_and_memory_budget.global_ledger: Parent must verify remaining time under the cumulative36GPU-hour project ledger before admission. The old60min-per-fit cap does not automatically authorize this zero-fit evaluation.
runtime_and_memory_budget.concurrency: One GPU job at a time, including the smoke. Do not overlap any arm with another training/evaluation/render job.

approved_smoke.scope: One parent-approved12s/480frame engineering clip after protocol binding and identity clearance. Exercise all3 frozen arms under the same proposed config/common noise within the same5min total cap. Record load time, forward time, peak hostRAM/VRAM and generator/read receipts only; do not compute missing section metrics or choose a seed/cohort from outputs.
approved_smoke.limitation: A12s no-prime clip underestimates full3439frame chunk attention and AR sampling overhead. Extrapolation must include the fullchunk/1039prime workload below. An inconclusive memory/time bound means STOP, not silent fullcohort launch.

runtime_and_memory_budget.memory_note: These are conservative policy ceilings, not measured usage or a promise that the source fits. Monitor the entire job/process tree and fail before crossing either cap; do not treat parameter size as a peak-memory estimate.

static_workload_from_identity_metadata.meaning: Metadata count only: each model samples ARflow for every frame in each full input chunk, including repeated prime context;3Euler velocity evaluations per sampled frame. Includes no measured throughput and no allowance for source/version overhead.

runtime_and_memory_budget.preflight: Use separately approved smoke timings and source-aware fullchunk/priming bounds to estimate fullarm runtime and RAM/VRAM conservatively. Parent checks remaining36h ledger and bound admission before the fullcohort. Log actual elapsed and peaks against each cap.
runtime_and_memory_budget.if_caps_do_not_fit: STOP and report blocked. No reduced seeds, shortercohort, omitted arm/null/component, alteredchunking, lowerprecision, or hidden extraGPUjob. Any alternative requires a new parent-approved protocol amendment before outcomes.
